# Rudraksh Safar
> Visa assistance for Indian travellers. Share documents on WhatsApp or email and our team files the application. Tourist, visitor, group and student visas for 150+ countries. Vietnam in under 60 minutes* and UAE in 4 hours* (*working days, office hours, complete documents).

## Country visa pages
- [USA visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/usa/): B1/B2 visitor visa. Stay: Decided at the port of entry (commonly up to 6 months). Government fee: US$185 visa fee.
- [UAE (Dubai) visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/uae/): Tourist e-visa, issued through a licensed sponsor. Stay: 30, 60 or 90 days depending on visa type. Government fee: About AED 252 to 285 (30 days, single entry).
- [Indonesia (Bali) visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/indonesia/): e-VOA or Visa on Arrival. Stay: 30 days, extendable once by 30 days. Government fee: IDR 500,000 (visa on arrival).
- [Thailand visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/thailand/): Visa-free tourism entry plus Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC). Stay: Up to 30 days (from 15 Sep 2026). Government fee: Free (TDAC).
- [China visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/china/): L (tourist) visa. Stay: Depends on the visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Saudi Arabia visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/saudi-arabia/): Tourist e-visa or visa on arrival if eligible, otherwise a visa through an authorised centre. Stay: As per the visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Vietnam visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/vietnam/): Tourist e-visa (online). Stay: e-visa valid up to 90 days, multiple entry. Government fee: US$25 single entry, US$50 multiple entry.
- [Malaysia visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/malaysia/): Visa-free tourism entry plus MDAC. A visa is expected from 1 Jan 2027 unless extended. Stay: Up to 30 days. Government fee: MDAC is free.
- [Qatar visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/qatar/): Free visa waiver on arrival (conditions apply). Stay: Up to 30 days. Government fee: Free waiver (conditions apply).
- [Singapore visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/singapore/): Short-visit visa filed through authorised channels. Stay: As per the visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [France visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/france/): Schengen short-stay visa (VFS appointment). Stay: Up to 90 days in any 180. Government fee: €90 adult, €45 child (6 to 11).
- [Australia visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/australia/): Visitor visa (subclass 600). Stay: As granted (commonly up to 3 months). Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Europe (Schengen) visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/europe/): Schengen short-stay visa for multiple countries. Stay: Up to 90 days in any 180. Government fee: €90 adult, €45 child (6 to 11).
- [Russia visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/russia/): Tourist e-visa (online). Stay: Short stay set by the e-visa. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Jordan visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/jordan/): Tourist visa (route confirmed on chat). Stay: As per the visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Sri Lanka visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/sri-lanka/): Free tourist ETA (online). Stay: 30 days, double entry (per the official portal). Government fee: Free (tourist ETA).
- [Hong Kong visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/hong-kong/): Visa-free visit with free Pre-Arrival Registration (PAR). Stay: Up to 14 days. Government fee: Free (PAR).
- [United Kingdom visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/uk/): Standard Visitor visa. Stay: Up to 6 months. Government fee: £135 (Standard Visitor, 6 months).
- [Canada visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/canada/): Visitor visa (TRV). Stay: As granted by the officer. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Japan visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/japan/): Tourist visa. Stay: As per the visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [South Korea visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/south-korea/): Short-term visit visa. Stay: As per the visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Turkey visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/turkey/): e-Visa if you hold a valid US, UK or Schengen visa, otherwise an embassy visa. Stay: As per the visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Azerbaijan visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/azerbaijan/): e-Visa (ASAN). Stay: As per the e-visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Georgia visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/georgia/): e-Visa. Stay: As per the e-visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Egypt visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/egypt/): Tourist visa (e-visa where available). Stay: As per the visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Cambodia visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/cambodia/): e-Visa. Stay: As per the e-visa issued. Government fee: Confirmed in your quote.
- [Maldives visa from India](https://www.rudrakshsafar.com/visa/maldives/): Free visa on arrival (30 days). Stay: 30 days. Government fee: Free (visa on arrival).
